name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis, including an in-driver taste-funnel explore state and design-ratification state) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each `--via loop`; /spec:design, /spec:build, and /spec:review remain each stage's direct entry, spec-build-driver.js and spec-review-driver.js stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros, and verdict derived by verdict.js, with test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, repair, reviewer dispatch, and dispositions held by the session) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.59.0 — manifest-stamped review scope (specs/20260902/05-manifest-stamped-scope.md): `review-legs.js` stamps every row it appends with `scope: "full"|"fix-delta"` (its own writer only; `ac-matrix.js`/`promise-sweep.js` rows are unchanged); `verdict.js` derives the review profile's required-leg set from those manifest rows (carriers must agree; none means `full`; disagreement or a value outside the enum invalidates the manifest) and never from the reviewer's return, printing one stderr diagnostic naming the missing legs or the invalid row on `UNVERIFIED`; the review-profile ledger row and retained artifact carry that same manifest-derived `scope` on every row, hard-stop rows included. `spec-review-driver.js --mark dispositions` now refuses (exit 2, no write) when the pass is `UNVERIFIED`, printing the verdict diagnostic plus the sidecar path and the bare re-run command — dispositions cannot cure missing evidence. The reviewer return contract drops `scope`: `spec/commands/review.md` and `spec/agents/reviewer.md` now name `{verdict, survivors, killed, reviewerCount, tokens}`; a return that still carries `scope` is accepted and the key ignored. 7.58.0 — host generators stop planting narration (specs/20260902/04-host-generators-owner-citations.md): init-gen's rendered rules-file Gotchas header, `/spec:review`'s CLOSE fold, and `/spec:escape`'s Gotchas draft all emit tag + rule + one owner citation (spec path, AC-ID, D-number, ADR, run id) and never dates, people, hosts, versions, or prior behavior; the grounding contract states that duty in § Session grounding and is re-hashed (this repo's own `.claude/spec.config.json` re-stamped), and its own three narrated lines are reworded in the same edit. The plugin-wide narration baseline file is deleted — the standing scan runs at zero with no baseline. Hosts: run `/spec:doctor` to approve the contract re-stamp, then apply the check 16 line-item patches it reports. 7.57.4 — reviewer kill standard (spec/agents/reviewer.md § The evidence standard): a dismissal binds to the same executed-evidence bar as a finding — a weakened identity or boundary check (`===`→`includes`/`startsWith`/`indexOf`, anchored→unanchored regex, full-token→substring) is a finding unless the reviewer constructs the colliding input the loosened check newly accepts and shows it cannot reach that site; fixture-equivalence ("every current id is the same length", "the pinned tests still pass") is never a kill. Owner: replay `rp_c88b27bf13b2` (salon-os, corpus class `prefix-collision-coverage-fail-open`, outcome missed); verified by the next replay on that class, not by a unit test.
